title: Huayno - Wikipedia
text: Huayno (Waynu in Quechua) [1] is a genre of popular Andean music and dance. It is especially common in Peru, western Bolivia, northwest Argentina and northern Chile, and is popular among the indigenous peoples, especially the Quechua people.

title: Ayacucho Quechua - Wikipedia
text: Ayacucho is a variety of Southern Quechua spoken in the Ayacucho Region, Peru, as well as by immigrants from Ayacucho in Lima.
